name: HOARD
description: Durable agent memory that survives session resets. Structured markdown persistence with provenance, auto-expiry, and consolidation. Storage directory is validated — set config.memoryDir to a dedicated folder.

memoryDir.description: Absolute path to the memory directory. Defaults to ./memory. Must be a dedicated storage folder — not home, root, or system directories.

autoExpire.description: Enable automatic expiry of old entries (default: true)

consolidateOnStartup.description: Run consolidation on plugin startup (default: false)
